'''MR-T3''' was a black [[R4 astromech droid/Legends|R4 astromech droid]], which was used at the [[Republic military base]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

==History==
MR-T3 accompanied an [[RA-7 protocol droid/Legends|RA-7 protocol droid]] designated [[R-A7/Legends|R-A7]] at the [[Republic military base]] when [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] [[Escape from the Republic military base/Legends|escaped]] from the [[Clone shock trooper/Legends|clone shock troopers]], after being suspected on murdering [[Letta Turmond/Legends|Letta Turmond]] and three [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]]. Tano almost kicked up the droid while jumping over it, making the droid spin around.
